theorems.statement: (∀ (N k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)), ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) ∧ tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) ⊆ {x : Euclid N | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) : Euclid (N + 1)) ∈ tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1))}) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) k), ∃ ρ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, ∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (ρ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)) (θ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) → ∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid N), ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, exteriorDerivative (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 1 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))) - (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))) - exteriorDerivative (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v) ∧ (∀ (N : ℕ) (β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) 0) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin 0 → Euclid N), ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, exteriorDerivative (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 1 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))) - (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid N) k) (f : ℝ → Covector (Euclid N) k) (c : ℝ), Continuous f → (∀ v : Fin k → Euclid N, α v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, f t v) → (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, covectorEuclideanNorm (f t) ≤ c) → covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ c
